annotations.title: Crypto prices in USD for up to 20 tokens in one call: get USD prices for several crypto tokens or coins in one call

description: USD prices for up to 20 crypto tokens in one call, by ticker (ETH, BTC, USDC, AERO…) or ERC-20 0x address, on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism, each from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH, read live from the chain, with pool, reserve and a thin-liquidity flag. Tokens without a pool are listed under unpriced instead of failing the call. Spot prices. Use to value a basket of tokens or refresh a watchlist in one paid call. Example: symbols=ETH,BTC,AERO. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

addresses.description: Comma-separated 0x ERC-20 token addresses (with or instead of symbols; 1-20 tokens in all)

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

symbols.description: Comma-separated tickers such as ETH,BTC,AERO (with or instead of addresses; 1-20 tokens in all)
